messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: P2 - potential data leak from embed-service (svc-embeddings-prod). Incident ID: INC-2026-0423. Pager: Anya. Link: https://pager.example/INC-2026-0423
Anya: I'm up. Joining bridge: https://meet.example/bridge/INC-2026-0423. Quick triage: Are we seeing exfil or accidental logging?
Jamal: on my way, starting log tail: `kubectl logs -n embeddings svc-embeddings-prod -f --since=10m` — initial error shows 502 retries to S3 behind upload...
Anya: flagging privacy — @Olivia (Privacy) can you join? We may have returned raw user data in a debug path.
Olivia (Privacy): joining. Can you confirm sample request/response? Need to know if PII included (emails, api_key, tokens).
Anya: pasting redacted sample (removing tokens): ```REQUEST: POST /v1/embeddings body: {"input":"<user_text>","id":"abc123"} RESPONSE: 200 body: {"embedding":[...], "debug": {"user_payload":"<POSSIBLE-PII>","session_id":"s-987"}}``` Not sure how debug got there.
Jamal: checking code path: looks like a feature flag `INCLUDE_DEBUG_IN_RESPONSES=true` flipped in prod config by mistake. Investigating when it changed: `kubectl get configmap embeddings-config -o yaml | grep INCLUDE_DEBUG`.
Anya: mitigation plan: 1) flip flag to false 2) purge debug responses from cache 3) invalidate any retained logs with debug content 4) run search for exposures. Jamal - can you flip flag and roll?
Jamal: flipping now, rolling restart on svc-embeddings-prod (rolling policy 1 pod at a time). Command: `kubectl set env deploy/embeddings INCLUDE_DEBUG_IN_RESPONSES=false -n embeddings` — kicking rollout.
ops-bot: deploybot: Rollout started for deploy/embeddings at 1772004629 by Jamal. 1/3 pods updated.
Anya: good. Olivia — while we confirm scope, let's draft status page and customer notification options. We need options: "no customer data exposed", "some debug fields contained user identifiers", or "PII confirmed". Use conservative language.
Olivia (Privacy): agree. If PII is present we need to notify affected customers and consider regulator timelines. I need counts: how many requests contained debug payloads in the window when flag was true?
Jamal: running quick query against request logs (clickhouse): `SELECT count(*) FROM embeddings_requests WHERE debug IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-14T22:00' AND now()` — returning ~1,124 rows so far. Pulling sample rows for inspection.
Sophia: product impact: which customers? Any enterprise tenants? We need to identify accounts and DSAs to prioritize outreach.
Jamal: sample shows mostly user_id hashes, but some email-like strings appear. Need to confirm deterministic PII extraction. I'll handoff to data-team after rotation.
Anya: status page draft (short): "Investigating: potential exposure of debug payloads in embeddings API. We are actively mitigating (feature flag rollback) and assessing scope. We'll update in 2 hours or sooner." Suggested as INPROGRESS.
statusbot: statuspage: draft created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0423/draft
Olivia (Privacy): Draft customer notification placeholder: "We are investigating a potential exposure that may have included debug fields containing user-supplied content. We are assessing scope; at this time no confirmed PII for the majority of requests. We will notify affected customers directly as soon as we confirm the scope and within regulatory timeframes." Use softer language, avoid certainties.
Anya: suggested internal template for "required disclosures" checklist: bullets: Confirm affected accounts, classify data (PII/non-PII), retention (were logs persisted?), remediation steps taken, timeline, point of contact.
Jamal: quick note — logs persisted to S3 for 36 hours before lifecycle policy. Need to run S3 purge on debug prefix: `aws s3 rm s3://redwood-logs/embeddings/debug/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*"` — but consult retention/compliance before deletion.
Olivia (Privacy): Do not delete anything until we snapshot for legal/regulator; make a secure snapshot, then proceed with purge if allowed. Capture hashes and sample records.
Anya: on-call handoff at +30m: Jamal will continue triage; Anya to prepare external comms and loop in SOC if necessary. @Sophia to coordinate CS outreach if enterprise tenants impacted.
Sophia: prepping a customer outreach list — sending to CS now. Draft email subject: "Important: Potential debug data exposure in embeddings API"
Sophia: draft snippet for customers (internal): ```Hi <Customer>, We're currently investigating a potential issue in our embeddings API that may have returned debug information from some requests. We are rolling a fix, assessing impact, and will follow up with details and mitigation steps. Contact: cs@redwood.ai.```
Anya: capture decision points: confirm PII? -> if yes, prepare 72-hour notification plan and regulator list; if no, prepare limited affected-customer notice with remediation steps.
Olivia (Privacy): I'll own classification and regulatory eval. Need dataset export and sample indices by end of shift. Also loop in legal if PII confirmed.
Jamal: logs show 1,124 candidate events, of which ~40 have strings matching email regex. Running enrichment to map to accounts.
ops-bot: monitoring: alert suppressed for 15m while roll completes.
Anya: next update in 20 minutes. If we confirm customer impact, prepare public status update + targeted emails. No public tweet drafts yet.
Jamal: enrichment done — mapping to 27 distinct customer accounts, 4 of which are enterprise. Pushing list to secure channel.
Anya: ok. Olivia, Sophia — please review outreach copy in secure CS channel. Jamal — hold on deletion until privacy confirms snapshot.
Olivia (Privacy): received list. Preparing classification. Also adding recommended disclosure language for notices to customers and regulators.
Anya: closing notes for thread: link to post-incident checklist and postmortem owner assignment: `https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0423/postmortem` — assign to Jamal for technical, Olivia for privacy, Sophia for customer comms. We'll update status page after confirmation.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 moved to "Mitigating". Next update scheduled at 1772005767.
Anya: thanks team. Handoff complete to Jamal (next 4h oncall).
